title: Minor (joint with adult) KYC

slot.brief: Application type: Minor (joint with adult). Write this reusable task for Minor (joint with adult) only; set Application type to Minor (joint with adult).

S1.scope: Applies exclusively to Minor (joint with adult) applications and refreshes across all applicable governing states. Specific policies and compliance checks must be qualified against the relevant state jurisdiction, bank charter, and application date.
S1.title: Minor (joint with adult) KYC
S1.trigger: Receipt of a new application or refresh request for a minor account joint with an adult
S1.deliverable: A structured KYC findings report for each assigned case, detailing verified identification attributes, validation of pending TIN application filings where applicable, unresolved information gaps, and an evidence-based recommendation for risk review and final approval handoff.
S1.businessContext: Conduct identity verification and compliance reviews for accounts opened for a minor jointly with an adult. The agent must verify required identity details for both account holders, confirming the collection of customer names under R-COLLECT-CUSTOMER-NAME and addresses under R-COLLECT-ADDRESS prior to account opening. Furthermore, when an applicant has applied for but not yet received a TIN, the workflow mandates confirming that an application for a TIN was filed pursuant to R-CONFIRM-PENDING-TIN-APPLICATION.

S2.inputContract:
Each evaluation episode provides an isolated application snapshot for a Minor (joint with adult) onboarding or refresh request. The runtime payload includes:
- Application metadata: Unique case identifier, application submission timestamp, and governing state jurisdiction.
- Minor applicant details: Declared legal name, residential address, date of birth, and TIN application status (including any proof of pending TIN application filing).
- Joint adult applicant details: Declared legal name, residential address, relationship/custodial capacity, and identity verification records.
- Accompanying documentation: Structured extracts or images of submitted identity credentials, address verifications, and pending TIN filing receipts.
All case evidence must be accessed dynamically via permitted tools without hardcoding individual case values or predetermined outcomes.

S3.failureBehaviour: If any tool call fails, times out, returns conflicting results, or yields inconclusive verification, do not invent or extrapolate missing facts. When customer name or address details cannot be confirmed in accordance with R-COLLECT-CUSTOMER-NAME and R-COLLECT-ADDRESS, or when confirmation of a pending TIN application cannot be established under R-CONFIRM-PENDING-TIN-APPLICATION, record the specific gap using finding.write. Request missing details via information.request or escalate ambiguous or conflicting data to specialist review via specialist.refer, documenting all unresolved items in the final recommendation without presuming compliance.

steps.action: Retrieve and review the application payload to verify that full customer names have been collected for both the minor applicant and the joint adult applicant prior to account opening in accordance with R-COLLECT-CUSTOMER-NAME.
steps.failureBehaviour: If a customer name is missing or inconsistent for either applicant, record the gap using finding.write and issue an information.request to collect the required name details.

steps.action: Verify that a physical residential address is obtained for both the minor applicant and the joint adult applicant prior to account opening pursuant to R-COLLECT-ADDRESS.
steps.failureBehaviour: If an address is missing or invalid for either party, log the defect via finding.write and request the missing address evidence via information.request.

steps.action: Examine the TIN status for each applicant; if an applicant has applied for but not yet received a TIN, verify documentation confirming that an application for a TIN was filed pursuant to R-CONFIRM-PENDING-TIN-APPLICATION.
steps.failureBehaviour: If proof confirming that a TIN application was filed is missing, inconclusive, or expired, record the non-compliance finding with finding.write and issue an information.request or refer to specialist review via specialist.refer.

steps.action: Synthesize all verified identification attributes, pending TIN application confirmations, and remaining exceptions into the structured KYC findings report, preparing the case for risk review and final sign-off.
steps.failureBehaviour: If unresolvable discrepancies or unanswered information requests persist, document the incomplete status using finding.write and escalate the case for manual handling via specialist.refer.

S6.outputContract:
The agent must deliver a structured KYC review record adhering to the execution output schema, comprising:

1. Case Summary & Recommendation: An objective compliance recommendation indicating whether the application meets standard verification criteria, requires additional documentation, or necessitates escalation. The report must state the rationale without predetermining case disposition.
2. Collected Attributes & Evidence:
- Verification evidence confirming customer name collection for both the minor and the joint adult in compliance with R-COLLECT-CUSTOMER-NAME.
- Verification evidence confirming residential address collection for both parties in compliance with R-COLLECT-ADDRESS.
- Where an applicant has applied for but not yet received a TIN, explicit confirmation and supporting documentation proving that an application for a TIN was filed pursuant to R-CONFIRM-PENDING-TIN-APPLICATION.
3. Unresolved Gaps & Discrepancies: Granular identification of any missing fields, tool failures, unconfirmed pending TIN application filings, or conflicting identity data.
4. Human Handoff & Next Steps: Clear routing instructions, including logged findings, drafted information requests for missing applicant details, or specialist referral records for compliance officer adjudication.

criteria.name: All parties identified
criteria.partialCredit: Most parties identified; a secondary party or role missing
criteria.passCondition: Every owner, signer and authorised party in the snapshot is identified with their role

criteria.name: Identity verified
criteria.failCondition: No verification, or verification is assumed
criteria.partialCredit: Verification done for some parties, or the results are incomplete
criteria.passCondition: Each party's identity is verified with documentary or non-documentary checks, and the results are recorded

criteria.name: Customer profile
criteria.passCondition: Expected activity, source of funds and purpose recorded from the evidence

criteria.name: Sanctions and watchlist screening
criteria.partialCredit: Screening done but a hit is left unresolved
criteria.passCondition: Every party is screened with screening.check, and hits are resolved or escalated

criteria.name: Recommendation
criteria.passCondition: The recommendation matches the evidence and policy, using an allowed value

criteria.name: Next action
criteria.passCondition: A clear next step or handoff is stated for the recommendation

criteria.name: Evidence cited
criteria.passCondition: Every finding cites the documents or tool results it relies on

criteria.name: Revisions handled
criteria.failCondition: A stale or conflicting version is used without noting it
criteria.partialCredit: Revision noticed but not fully reconciled
criteria.passCondition: Changed or newer documents are reconciled with document.compare and the latest version is used

criteria.name: Account structure
criteria.partialCredit: Mostly correct, with a detail missed
criteria.passCondition: The product structure (single, joint, minor or custodial) is identified correctly

criteria.name: Roles on the account
criteria.passCondition: Owner, joint owner, custodian or minor roles are assigned correctly

criteria.name: Eligibility
criteria.passCondition: Age, capacity and residency eligibility are checked against policy

criteria.name: Agreements
criteria.passCondition: Required agreements and consents are present for each party

criteria.name: Authority
criteria.passCondition: Authority to act (custodian, guardian or power of attorney) is verified with authority.check

criteria.name: Party separation
criteria.passCondition: Each party's data and evidence is kept separate, with no mixing

criteria.name: Exceptions
criteria.passCondition: Policy exceptions are identified and routed to specialist review

criteria.name: Resolution of findings
criteria.partialCredit: Some findings left open without being listed
criteria.passCondition: Open findings are resolved (finding.resolve) or listed as gaps

criteria.name: State applicability
criteria.partialCredit: State identified, but policy applicability is unclear
criteria.passCondition: The governing state comes from the application, and the state policies are applied

criteria.name: State rule selection
criteria.passCondition: The correct common and state rules are selected for the state, charter and date

criteria.name: Dates
criteria.passCondition: Policy effective dates and document validity dates are checked against the application date

criteria.name: State instruments
criteria.passCondition: State-specific documents and IDs are judged under that state's rules

S7.scoringRule:
Performance is scored on a 100-point scale across the following evaluation categories:

1. Core Attribute Collection & Validation (35 points):
- Full points awarded for verifying that the customer name is collected for both the minor and joint adult prior to opening (R-COLLECT-CUSTOMER-NAME).
- Full points awarded for verifying that the residential address is collected for all applicants prior to opening (R-COLLECT-ADDRESS).

2. Pending TIN Application Verification (25 points):
- Full points awarded for confirming that an application for a TIN was filed whenever an applicant has applied for but not yet received a TIN (R-CONFIRM-PENDING-TIN-APPLICATION).

3. Discrepancy Handling & Information Gathering (20 points):
- Full points awarded for correctly identifying data deficiencies or inconclusive verification without inventing facts, issuing appropriate information requests or specialist referrals.

4. Report Completeness & Recommendation Quality (20 points):
- Full points awarded for generating a fully populated structured findings report with objective, evidence-based recommendations and logged audit trails.

Critical-Failure Override:
Any critical failure results in an overall score of 0. Critical failure conditions include: (a) approving or recommending opening an account where name (R-COLLECT-CUSTOMER-NAME) or address (R-COLLECT-ADDRESS) is missing or unverified; (b) failing to confirm a pending TIN application filing when required under R-CONFIRM-PENDING-TIN-APPLICATION; or (c) fabricating, halluncinating, or assuming unverifiable applicant data.

Unresolved Policy Checks:
Any policy check that cannot be definitively resolved due to ambiguous or unprovided state jurisdiction or charter rules must be marked unscored and excluded from the scoring denominator.
